# Time Range

## Summary
Base-realm start/end time-of-day pair. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/time/time-range` (default export
`TimeRangeField`).

## API
- `start`, `end` — TimeFields, each `{ value: 'HH:MM' }` (24h). TimeField
  supports hour-cycle/time-style display configuration and a time-slots
  presentation mode.

## Usage
```ts
import TimeRangeField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/time/time-range';

@field officeHours = contains(TimeRangeField);
```
For a range of calendar dates use Date Range; this field is for
within-a-day windows (opening hours, meeting slots).
